# A current coded positive Gaussian leaf

Prepared for **@CubeJerry**, with substantial OpenAI assistance in source
analysis, implementation, mathematics and verification. Apache-2.0.

## 1. Exact claim and predecessor boundary

This package connects Jose Manuel's [#3091](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3091)
complete physical Gaussian leaf to the current compiled caller's coded numeric
field and twenty-three-field descriptor. The actual selected source occurrence
is the positive rank-one `PAID` event between the two adapters of local MOVE
9896, `["MOVE",236,3,7,false]`, in the selected #6030 word. It does **not**
execute the two monomial adapters, the full MOVE or the full selected caller.

The complete old C/inverse-C arithmetic, exact acceptance theorem, encoded
axis traversal, finite scratch allocation and direct `O(f V)` tariff are
credited predecessor results, reused unchanged. The present contribution is
their current-format, current-descriptor and actual-token composition,
including a physically erased return, explicit leaf-domain guard and all
additional source/format/setup/backing charges. It constructs no ordinary BIT
supplier and invokes no ordinary callback. This removes that service premise
from this particular direct leaf; it does not accelerate a nonleaf call.

The published `compiled-compact-native-binding` at
`5629e7772d1720d6727465e328a45694f8620538` supplies the current symbol codec,
read-only header parser and one shared old Count/Tape vocabulary. Its Compact
and ordinary algorithms are not invoked by the new provider. Its source
refinement remains an explicit inherited premise. The concurrently developed
current monomial adapter is neither imported nor claimed anew. The current
ADD/SCALE work is also separate. #6890/#6900/#6901 establish other ideal
operator/precision statements; this package claims none of them anew.

The result is an executable **structured finite-control, fixed-inventory tape
refinement**, not an emitted `Controller.execute_table` service table. Fixed
control/role metadata lives in the source program; varying widths, address
coordinates, counters and payload are encoded on the supplied tapes. The
unchanged old source uses a fixed bound on simultaneous Count/Tape roles.
It does not allocate a new physical tape for each record, axis or column.

## 2. Current interface and quantified statement

Supply a `CodedPort` numeric field and a `BinaryContextPort` descriptor at
their protected current origins. Supply 349 fixed, genuinely disjoint,
initially physically blank owned work segments, also at their origins. Caller
ancestors precede those origins and are outside the writable segments. Distinct
wrapper identities alone do not prove that two segments are disjoint: actual
segment separation is a caller premise. The guards reject shared raw objects
and duplicate work ports before numerical execution.

The descriptor has the exact current order

```
outer, rows, stock, row_bits, within_bits, record_bits, p, d, K, G, H,
q0, qF, qB, D, f, rho, active_start, back_start, selected_axes,
entry_start, remainder, cutoff.
```

Each integer has a positive unary binary-digit length, zero separator and
canonical least-significant-first binary digits. Its complete physical
frontier follows field 23. The entire descriptor is read, charged and returned
unchanged, including fields unused by this direct primitive.

Write `a=within_bits`, `u=active_start`, `b=record_bits`, `C=outer*rows`.
Require positive `outer, rows, f, K, cutoff`, and

```
0 <= rho < K,     u+fK <= a,     f <= cutoff.
```

These are the local leaf requirements. The current producer's stronger
placement, stock and root-reservation equalities remain separate caller
premises. The service does not silently change them. A current descriptor
with `f>cutoff` is rejected before payload mutation, rather than executing an
unpriced direct replacement for a recursive child.

Every address record contains `r>=1` complex coefficients on one fixed common
grid, each component stored in `h>=2` least-significant-first two's-complement
bits followed by virtual delimiter 2. Real precedes imaginary. Current
virtual symbols use three physical bits. Thus

```
b = 6 r(h+1),       row_bits = 2^a b,
V = C 2^a b,        R = 2hr,       Vraw = C 2^a R.
```

Each successive component has the same width and delimiter; every coefficient
and every spectator address is present. The wrapper verifies `b`, the complete
row extent and all input/return frontiers. It never obtains a payload length
from a host array or a hardware head address.

For an address `x`, define the current selected positions counted from the
left by `u+jK+rho`, `0<=j<f`. Let

\[
C_1=\frac12\begin{pmatrix}1+i&1-i\\1-i&1+i\end{pmatrix}.
\]

**Theorem.** Under the preceding interface and the exact-grid/signed-prefix
conditions below, the positive provider replaces each complete selected
fibre by `C_1^{tensor f}`, for every positive f, preserving all other address
bits, outer/row labels, coefficient indices, the common grid, complete
delimiters and descriptor. The inverse provider replaces it by the inverse
tensor with the same contract. All borrowed public/context heads return to
their origins. All reached owned current segments, including coded old blanks,
are physically blank at return and no ancestor cell is touched.

The source kernel rejects an inexact half or an out-of-range signed result.
On those named arithmetic failures for otherwise admitted input, the current
field and descriptor remain unchanged; all owned work is erased and the same
fixed inventory can accept a subsequent valid call. The cutoff check has the
same pre-payload failure boundary. No rollback theorem is asserted for an
arbitrary malformed stream, source corruption or interruption.

## 3. Exact geometry and source C normalization

The old leaf uses the fixed three-field schema

| Field | Width | Current address interval |
|---|---:|---|
| before | u | all coordinates before the selected block |
| selected | fK | the selected block |
| after | a-u-fK | every remaining coordinate |

The widths sum to a and are nonnegative. All before/after bits may be dirty;
they are spectators, not zero-initialized helpers. The original records and
coefficient order remain unchanged. No grouping, gathering, permutation or
suffix truncation is implicit in this equality of complete stream layouts.

The old low-bit offset is `rho_old=K-1-rho`. Its selected low-bit positions
`rho_old+jK` correspond to the current left-counted positions with column
ordinal `f-1-j`. Consequently the old forward traversal enumerates the same
distinct axes in reverse order. Different C tensor factors commute because
they act on disjoint address coordinates; their product is exactly the stated
current tensor. The inverse traversal uses the inverse factors and reverses
that order. No phase is tensor-powered outside its declared factor.

The selected word is authenticated at canonical base
`7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. The retained current source lowering
places `SERVICE(move-in)`, positive `PAID(rank=1)` and `SERVICE(move-out)` in
that exact chronological order on owner 236. The retained absolute-phase
Clifford compiler confirms that the transition has Fourier rank one. The
two complete columns of its positive Fourier factor are

```
((1+i)/2, (1-i)/2),    ((1-i)/2, (1+i)/2).
```

This is exactly #3091's C. It is neither an unnormalized Walsh butterfly nor
a Hadamard requiring another power-of-two normalization. The source binder
checks both columns, their denominator, the precise token, rank and owner.
It leaves the surrounding source monomials explicit; omitting either would
not produce the complete MOVE.

## 4. Signed format and returned ownership

The wrapper counts the first component's formatting bits on an encoded Count
tape. It does not decode that component as an integer. It divides `b` by
`6(h+1)`, requiring zero remainder and positive quotient r. It constructs
the three encoded widths, `rho_old` and the positive outer-row count C with
the retained Count operations. It checks the exact `row_bits` value.

`import_field` scans the current field in order, copies all h signed bits and
checks/skips its delimiter, for both components of every coefficient. It
keeps redundant sign bits and leading zero bits. It appends a guide symbol
for each current virtual symbol and uses that guide to restore the public
head. Therefore the raw borrowed packet is precisely `C 2^a` records with
r complete h-bit Gaussian coefficients. The unchanged old engine verifies
the entire raw length against its encoded dimensions, so an omitted or extra
complete coefficient cannot be ignored.

The parent allocation scope is suspended while the old leaf operates on this
separate borrowed raw packet. It produces a protected exact return and
preserves the raw input. Only after successful completion does `export_field`
write the current public field. It copies all returned signed bits, checks
the original delimiter positions, retains those delimiters and verifies
agreement of the old output, current field and guide frontiers. No rounding,
quantum change, leading-bit normalization or projection occurs.

The caller consumes that protected return immediately, clears its body and
marker, clears the raw bridge, closes every setup/header Count and then
physically retires all fixed owned segments. A later call cannot observe a
partial previous numerical result. On a named C rejection the predecessor
has already closed its axis/leaf state; the wrapper has not entered export,
and the same closure/retirement path erases the bridge and setup. Thus its
public input is untouched and its fixed inventory is reusable.

## 5. Numerical acceptance is not assumed from a final endpoint

#3091's unmodified finite-carry implementation forms each of the four C
numerators through four carry states, performs exact halving and checks the
retained signed result against two sign-extension steps. No unhalved h-bit
temporary is materialized. Its accepted domain is exactly the component
divisibility and signed-fit condition at each executed axis output.

This implementation cannot infer intermediate fit merely from the final
matrix image. A sufficient, explicitly credited uniform condition is the
older Gaussian tensor reserve and prefix norm: if each input encoded real
and imaginary component is divisible by `2^ceil(f/2)`, has absolute value at
most M and

```
2^ceil(f/2) M <= 2^(h-1)-1,
```

then every completed C prefix is integral and fits. The same result holds
for inverse C. Alejandro Zarzuelo Urdiales, Nick Petalas and the #3091 source
lineage already prove these bounds; this package does not claim a new reserve
lemma. A current whole-caller precision theorem may instead establish the
actual correlated prefix conditions. Such a transfer must identify its real
source states and cannot replace this theorem's premise by final-output fit.

## 6. Complete current time, backing and cutoff bill

Let E be the physical descriptor length, Q=349 the fixed owned-port inventory,
and `F_template` the input-independent source/finite-control compilation cost.
Let Z be this call's sum of reached old-symbol extents on its owned ports,
including coded blank extension. The inherited direct kernel costs
`T_leaf=O(f Vraw)` old-symbol work for f>=1, including encoded old setup,
complete-axis movement, cleanup, protected return and rejection cleanup.

Current format import/export and guide restoration cost O(V). The h-bit
component counter has O(h) aggregate initialization/decrement/cleanup cost;
there is no fresh long width scan per payload bit. The first-width scan is
included. Since the canonical `row_bits` binary digits have length at least
a and `b` records the coefficient/width factor, one-time encoded products,
division, comparison and power construction cost at most O((E+1)^4). This
deliberately conservative bound charges large unused metadata too.

The shared codec refines each old alphabet symbol to four virtual bits and
then twelve current physical positions. Its source-control and local-origin
guards have a fixed overhead factor, not a unit-cost address oracle. The new
leaf cohort needs no parking engine or ordinary object: 216 old engine
scratch roles, its protected output, 128 separate wrapper roles and four
persistent bridge/guide roles give exactly Q=349 ports. The setup live-role
census is fewer than 80, including all 23 header Counts and nested arithmetic
temporaries. Suspended wrapper roles and engine roles are physically distinct.

A complete physical bill is

```
T_current <= F_template + C_codec T_leaf
             + C (V + (E+1)^4 + Q) + 64 (Z+Q).
```

Every reached old symbol requires movement or initialization within this
call, so `Z=O(T_leaf+V+(E+1)^4+Q)`. Since `Vraw<=V`, this yields

```
T_current = F_template + O(fV + (E+1)^4 + Q).
```

The last displayed estimate includes copying, source access, formatting,
normalization, cleanup and all numerical leaf work. No faster nonleaf tariff
or empirical speedup is inferred from it. If the actual globally certified
cutoff is `max(N,floor(h^eta))`, then a successful branch has
`f<=N+h^eta` and the corresponding bound is
`F_template+O(V(N+h^eta)+(E+1)^4+Q)`. To compare it with a global selected
tariff one must still supply the actual N, eta, relation of h to the root
precision, the descriptor-growth law and all other caller charges. That
comparison is not asserted here.

For fresh calls, the source gives each of its finitely many roles backing
`O(Vraw+log(Vraw+1))`; wrapper guides/bridge need O(V) physical storage and
header/setup need a conservative O((E+1)^2). Multiplying old extents by twelve
and retaining fixed Q yields total fresh backing `O_Q(V+(E+1)^2+1)`, in
addition to the protected caller ancestor and public/context storage.
The predecessor's finer occupied-content bound is retained separately from
this conservative fixed-role backing bound.

Clearing erases contents without shrinking previously visited storage. At a
common fixed origin, the retained backing of role i after completed calls
1..j is at least its historical maximum and is bounded by the maximum of the
displayed per-call envelopes, plus origin/ancestor offsets. More explicitly,
if its old extent on call k is z_i(k) at physical origin o_i(k), charge

```
sum_i max_(k<=j) (o_i(k) + 12 z_i(k) + O(1)),
```

plus borrowed public/context backing and the caller continuation bank.
The same physical origins may be reused only after the source closure/erase
boundary. A smaller subsequent call encounters fresh physical blanks after
its own current frontier and does not rescan old blank historical backing.

## 7. Evidence and boundaries

The full current packets are checked against a separately written direct
Kronecker-coefficient matrix oracle. The oracle sums all `2^f` input values
for each selected-fibre output; it does not call the retained butterfly,
split/merge, carry code or helper alignment routines. It checks all records,
coefficients, signs and output format. Physical fixtures cover spaced offsets,
multiple outer/inner rows, forward/inverse tensors, dirty spectators, named
later-field parity and overflow failures, valid retry and shrinking history.

Source/token, alias, wrong-offset, wrong-direction and corrupted-source
controls reject. A no-ordinary-constructor control confirms the new direct
leaf does not depend on the older ordinary service. Normal and optimized
replays are regression/coverage evidence. The quantified claim follows from
the preceding source composition argument and its explicit premises, not from
finite sampling or rerunning one implementation.

The actual source token is exercised on a reduced current descriptor fixture;
it is not an execution of the enormous selected rank-nine complete packet.
No production native exponent, complete selected recurrence, flat-table
export, full source word or integer recovery is tested. All five selected
framework assumptions remain on the selected certificate. This is one
constructed physical leaf boundary, not a new kappa or an unconditional
integer-multiplication theorem.
